{{samename|[[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] product released in November 2014 during the XY Series|XY TCG Series merchandise#Hoenn Collection|XY TCG Series merchandise → Hoenn Collection}} ---- [[File:Pokémon Hoenn Collection.png|thumb|Pokémon Hoenn Collection cover]] [[File:Pokémon Hoenn Collection open.png|thumb|Pokémon Hoenn Collection opened]] The '''Pokémon Hoenn Collection''' is a Region 4 [[Collector's Pokédex Book]] DVD set released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on October 10, 2012 and in New Zealand on October 17, 2012. It contains 16 discs with 133 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13836. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all of the regular dubbed episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} that take place in [[Hoenn]]. It contains episodes from [[S06|Advanced]], [[S07|Advanced Challenge]], and [[S08|Advanced Battle]]. ==Book== The discs come in a large book, designed to resemble the Hoenn [[Pokédex]]. The front cover and back cover together include portraits of all 135 [[Generation III]] Pokémon. Inside the front cover is [[Media:Hoenn Anime.png|a map]] of the [[Hoenn]] region in the animated series. At the start of the book, there is a brief description of the main characters, having profiles for {{Ash}}, [[Ash's Pikachu]], {{an|Brock}}, {{an|May}}, and [[Max]]. There is also a page featuring images of each of Hoenn [[Badge]]s and a description of the [[Gym Leader]] that gives it ([[Juan]] is listed for the {{badge|Rain}}, and he is the Gym Leader Ash defeats to obtain it). The book has slots for two discs on each side of each page. Next to each disc in the book is an episode listing for that disc as well as a profile of a Pokémon that is featured in at least one of the episodes. This profile includes an original description, its [[height]] and [[weight]] (in metric units), its [[type]]s, its {{pkmn|category}}, its {{Abilities}} (but not its [[Hidden Ability]]), and its [[evolution]]ary line. The episodes are numbered from 1 to 133. {{-}} ==Contents== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Hoenn}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Hoenn}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
